Image inside an anchor produces a linked image

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"https://example.com\"><img src=\"icon.png\" alt=\"Icon\"></a>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
